title: authentik-operator Helm values
description: Values for the authentik-operator chart. The chart installs the operator only; it does not install authentik itself.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the first probe.

periodSeconds.description: How often to probe, in seconds.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which an individual probe attempt times out.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes required to consider the probe successful after a failure.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures required before the probe is considered failed.

replicaCount.description: Number of operator Pods. Leave at 1: leader election means only one replica reconciles. Raise to 2 only for faster failover during node drains.

repository.description: Operator image repository. Change only when mirroring into a private registry.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means use the chart's appVersion, keeping chart and operator in lockstep.

digest.description: Image digest (sha256:...). When set it wins over tag, giving immutable, verifiable deploys.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. IfNotPresent for released tags; Always only for moving tags such as main or latest.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of pre-existing image pull Secrets, needed only for a private image.repository. The Secret must already exist in the release namespace.

name.description: Name of an existing Secret of type kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name portion of generated resource names and the app.kubernetes.io/name label.

fullnameOverride.description: Replace the generated <release>-<chart> resource name entirely. Use to match an existing naming convention or to stay under the 63-character label limit.

create.description: Create the ServiceAccount. Set false when your platform pre-provisions ServiceAccounts, then set name.

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Empty means the generated fullname when create is true, or 'default' when it is false.

annotations.description: Annotations for the ServiceAccount, typically cloud workload identity (eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn, iam.gke.io/...).

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into the Pod. Must stay true unless credentials are injected another way.

rbac.description: RBAC objects created by the chart.

create.description: Create the ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding and leader-election Role/RoleBinding. Set false only when RBAC is managed out-of-band.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the operator Pod, e.g. service-mesh opt-out or secret-injector hints.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the operator Pod, e.g. cost allocation or NetworkPolicy selectors.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context. Defaults satisfy the restricted Pod Security Standard; change only if a policy engine demands different settings.

runAsNonRoot.description: Refuse to start if the image would run as UID 0.

runAsUser.description: UID to run the Pod as.

runAsGroup.description: Primary GID to run the Pod as.

fsGroup.description: Supplemental group applied to mounted volumes.

supplementalGroups.description: Additional groups added to the container's first process.

seccompProfile.description: Seccomp profile for all containers in the Pod.

type.description: Seccomp profile source. RuntimeDefault is required by the restricted PSS.

localhostProfile.description: Profile path on the node, relative to the kubelet's seccomp root. Only with type Localhost.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the manager. The operator writes nothing to disk, so the rootfs is read-only and all capabilities are dropped.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether a process can gain more privileges than its parent. Keep false.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the container root filesystem read-only. If something needs to write, mount an emptyDir via extraVolumes rather than relaxing this.

privileged.description: Run the container privileged. Never needed here.

runAsNonRoot.description: Container-level override of the Pod setting.

runAsUser.description: UID to run the container as.

runAsGroup.description: GID to run the container as.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities added to or dropped from the container.

drop.description: Capabilities to drop. ALL is the correct value for this operator.

add.description: Capabilities to add. Should stay empty.

resources.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the manager container. The operator is event-driven and mostly idle; raise limits if you manage thousands of resources or see OOMKills.

limits.description: Resource ceiling. Memory over-limit means OOMKill; CPU over-limit means throttling.

requests.description: Scheduling reservation. Kept small so the operator schedules anywhere.

claims.description: ResourceClaim references (Dynamic Resource Allocation). Not used by this operator.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the operator Pod. Use to keep the operator on a system node pool.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the operator Pod, needed when the eligible nodes carry taints.

affinity.description: Affinity/anti-affinity rules. With replicaCount 2, add pod anti-affinity so both replicas do not land on one node.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints; an alternative to affinity for spreading replicas across zones or nodes.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the operator Pod, e.g. system-cluster-critical, so it survives node pressure ahead of workloads. Must already exist.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period before SIGKILL. The manager stops controllers and releases the leader lease on SIGTERM; 10s is ample.

dnsPolicy.description: Pod DNS policy. Use None (with dnsConfig) only in clusters with unusual DNS topology.

dnsConfig.description: Custom DNS settings (nameservers, searches, options), used when dnsPolicy is None.

hostAliases.description: Entries added to the Pod's /etc/hosts, for when the authentik URL resolves only via DNS the cluster cannot reach.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the manager container in full Kubernetes env form, so valueFrom works. Typical uses: HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY, SSL_CERT_FILE.

value.description: Literal value. Mutually exclusive with valueFrom.

valueFrom.description: Source for the value: secretKeyRef, configMapKeyRef, fieldRef or resourceFieldRef.

extraArgs.description: Extra command-line flags appended to /manager. An escape hatch for flags newer than this chart version.

extraVolumes.description: Extra Pod volumes in full Kubernetes form. Most often a Secret/ConfigMap CA bundle for the authentik endpoint, or an emptyDir for a writable path.

name.description: Volume name, referenced by an extraVolumeMounts entry.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts on the manager container, matching extraVolumes by name.

name.description: Name of the volume to mount, from extraVolumes.

mountPath.description: Path inside the container to mount at.

subPath.description: Mount a single file or subdirectory of the volume.

readOnly.description: Mount read-only. Should be true for CA bundles and other config.

extraObjects.description: Extra Kubernetes manifests rendered with the release. Strings pass through tpl, so Helm templating works. Use for a NetworkPolicy or PodDisruptionBudget you want in the release.

level.description: Log verbosity (--zap-log-level). Use debug when diagnosing reconcile behaviour; it is noisy in steady state.

format.description: Log encoding (--zap-encoder). json for log pipelines, console for human-readable local debugging.

enabled.description: Enable leader election (--leader-elect). Keep true: without it, overlapping replicas during a rolling update reconcile the same objects and fight.

watchNamespaces.description: Namespaces the operator watches. Empty means all namespaces. Restricting shrinks cache memory and blast radius, but resources elsewhere are silently ignored.

port.description: Container port for /healthz and /readyz. Change only on a port collision with an injected sidecar.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the manager (GET /healthz). Raise initialDelaySeconds on very slow nodes.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the manager (GET /readyz). Governs when the Pod counts as available during a rolling update.

enableHTTP2.description: Enable HTTP/2 on the metrics endpoint (--enable-http2). Off by default because of HTTP/2's DoS-shaped CVE history; the operator gains nothing from it.

metrics.description: controller-runtime metrics endpoint and its exposure.

enabled.description: Serve controller-runtime metrics. When false the bind address is set to 0 and no Service is created.

port.description: Port the metrics endpoint binds to inside the container.

secure.description: Serve metrics over HTTPS with authn/authz (--metrics-secure). Keep true in shared clusters; false serves plaintext to anything that can reach the Pod.

enabled.description: Create a Service for metrics. Disable if you scrape Pods directly.

type.description: Service type. ClusterIP is correct; metrics should never leave the cluster.

annotations.description: Extra annotations on the metrics Service, e.g. annotation-based scrape config.

labels.description: Extra labels on the metrics Service, for Prometheus serviceMonitorSelector matching.

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the metrics endpoint.

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor. Requires the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 CRD, or the install fails on an unknown kind.

namespace.description: Namespace for the ServiceMonitor. Empty means the release namespace.

labels.description: Extra labels on the ServiceMonitor. Must match your Prometheus serviceMonitorSelector, or it is created and silently never scraped.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout. Empty means Prometheus' default. Must not exceed interval.

scheme.description: Scrape scheme. Empty derives it from metrics.secure (https when secure, http otherwise).

bearerTokenFile.description: Token file Prometheus presents to the metrics endpoint, required when metrics.secure authorises via SubjectAccessReview.

tlsConfig.description: TLS settings for the scrape. The metrics server uses a self-signed certificate by default, hence insecureSkipVerify.

honorLabels.description: Keep target label values when they collide with Prometheus' own.

metricRelabelings.description: metric_relabel_configs applied after the scrape; use to drop high-cardinality controller-runtime histograms.
